gloss: the Six Codes; Japanese legal code collection

definitions.gloss: the Six Codes; fundamental laws of Japan
definitions.explanation: The six fundamental bodies of Japanese law: the Constitution, Civil Code, Commercial Code, Criminal Code, Code of Civil Procedure, and Code of Criminal Procedure.
A reference book containing the main Japanese laws, commonly used by law students and legal professionals.

notes:
THE SIX CODES:
1. ⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧ (Constitution)
2. ⟦{民法|みんぽう}→民法：13239_minpou⟧ (Civil Code)
3. ⟦{商法|しょうほう}→商法：30086_shouhou⟧ (Commercial Code)
4. ⟦{刑法|けいほう}→刑法：15210_keihou⟧ (Criminal Code)
5. ⟦{民事|みんじ}→民事：27902_minji⟧⟦{訴訟法|そしょうほう}→訴訟法：30087_soshouhou⟧ (Code of Civil Procedure)
6. ⟦{刑事|けいじ}→刑事：02741_keiji⟧⟦{訴訟法|そしょうほう}→訴訟法：30087_soshouhou⟧ (Code of Criminal Procedure)

COMMON PRODUCTS:
・{六法|ろっぽう}⟦{全書|ぜんしょ}→全書：noentry⟧ (complete compendium of laws)
・⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧{六法|ろっぽう} (pocket-sized law book)
・⟦{判例|はんれい}→判例：30088_hanrei⟧{六法|ろっぽう} (law book with case precedents)

USAGE NOTE: In practice, {六法|ろっぽう} often refers to the physical book compiling these and other laws, not just the six specific codes.
